AI NEWS — Sat, 14 Nov 2026

TOP STORY
Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey Jones is the board's first chair. The FT reports Nvidia approached Arm's Rene Haas about the permanent job; reporting links the exit to two affairs, one with a woman described as an alleged Chinese spy.

5 KEY UPDATES
1. OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet: its dots agents can complete purchases with a Face ID check per order, using network-issued payment tokens instead of real card details. US ChatGPT Pro users first, no cut taken for now.
2. Google shipped Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens with a 1M-token window, reported 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and 51 on the Artificial Analysis index.
3. Anthropic's IPO book is reported roughly six times oversubscribed ahead of a 19 Nov Nasdaq listing under ANT; LangChain raised $300M at a $3B valuation.
4. Anthropic research found one shared coordinator agent beat teams of per-user agents by 10-45 points across four shared-resource settings, with far fewer unsupported claims.
5. Five nonprofits sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX seeking a halt to frontier model development, and weight analysis reported export-banned Blackwell GPUs in leading Chinese models.

CONCEPT OF THE DAY: The agent gets a wallet — approval, payment tokens and liability now matter more than raw capability.
